requirements.quote:
For every TLS 1.3 ClientHello, this vector
      MUST contain exactly one byte, set to zero
requirements.condition: encoding or parsing a TLS 1.3 ClientHello
requirements.required_behavior: encode legacy_compression_methods as exactly one byte whose value is zero
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use another vector length or byte value
requirements.why_checkable: The vector length and sole byte can be checked directly on the wire.

requirements.quote:
If a
      TLS 1.3 ClientHello is received with any other value in this
      field, the server MUST abort the handshake with an
      "illegal_parameter" alert.
requirements.condition: a server receives a TLS 1.3 ClientHello whose legacy_compression_methods is not exactly the required zero byte
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept the malformed legacy compression field
requirements.why_checkable: Malformed vector lengths and nonzero values can be injected to observe the required alert.

requirements.quote:
TLS 1.3 servers might
      receive TLS 1.2 or prior ClientHellos which contain other
      compression methods and (if negotiating such a prior version) MUST
      follow the procedures for the appropriate prior version of TLS.
requirements.condition: a TLS 1.3-capable server receives a legacy ClientHello and negotiates TLS 1.2 or earlier
requirements.required_behavior: process compression methods using the procedures for the negotiated prior TLS version
requirements.forbidden_behavior: apply the TLS 1.3 zero-only rule to the negotiated prior-version handshake
requirements.why_checkable: Legacy ClientHello handling can be tested under a prior-version negotiation path.

requirements.condition: a server parses an unrecognized ClientHello extension
requirements.forbidden_behavior: reject the ClientHello solely because the extension is unrecognized
requirements.why_checkable: An unknown extension can be added to an otherwise valid ClientHello and server behavior observed.

requirements.quote:
TLS 1.3 ClientHello messages always
      contain extensions
requirements.condition: the message is a TLS 1.3 ClientHello
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode a TLS 1.3 ClientHello without extensions
requirements.why_checkable: The parser and serializer can be tested for mandatory field presence.

requirements.quote:
TLS 1.3 ClientHello messages always
      contain extensions (minimally "supported_versions", otherwise, they
      will be interpreted as TLS 1.2 ClientHello messages).
requirements.condition: the client constructs a TLS 1.3 ClientHello
requirements.required_behavior: include supported_versions in the extensions field
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omit supported_versions while intending the message to be interpreted as TLS 1.3
requirements.why_checkable: Extension presence and version classification are directly testable.

requirements.quote:
The presence of
      extensions can be detected by determining whether there are bytes
      following the compression_methods field at the end of the
      ClientHello.
requirements.condition: a server parses the optional extensions field of a legacy-compatible ClientHello
requirements.required_behavior: detect extension presence from whether bytes remain after compression_methods
requirements.forbidden_behavior: assume a separate variable-length wrapper exists for optional extension presence
requirements.why_checkable: Parser behavior can be exercised with a ClientHello ending at compression_methods and one with trailing extension bytes.

requirements.quote: TLS 1.3 servers will need to perform this check first
requirements.condition: a TLS 1.3-capable server begins ClientHello version negotiation
requirements.required_behavior: check for the extensions field before attempting TLS 1.3 negotiation
requirements.forbidden_behavior: attempt TLS 1.3 negotiation before determining whether extensions are present
requirements.why_checkable: The parser and negotiation call order can be inspected or instrumented.

requirements.quote:
only attempt to negotiate TLS 1.3 if the "supported_versions"
      extension is present.
requirements.required_behavior: gate TLS 1.3 negotiation on presence of supported_versions
requirements.forbidden_behavior: negotiate TLS 1.3 when supported_versions is absent
requirements.why_checkable: A ClientHello without supported_versions can verify that the TLS 1.3 negotiation path is not entered.

requirements.quote:
If negotiating a version of TLS prior to 1.3,
      a server MUST check that the message either contains no data after
      legacy_compression_methods or that it contains a valid extensions
      block with no data following.
requirements.condition: the server negotiates TLS earlier than 1.3
requirements.required_behavior: accept the ClientHello framing only if it ends after legacy_compression_methods or contains one valid extensions block followed by no data
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept malformed trailing bytes, an invalid extension block, or data after the extension block
requirements.why_checkable: Each legal and illegal trailing-data shape can be supplied to the prior-version parser.

requirements.quote:
If not, then it MUST abort the
      handshake with a "decode_error" alert.
requirements.condition: a prior-version ClientHello has data after legacy_compression_methods that is not exactly a valid final extensions block
requirements.forbidden_behavior: continue after the framing validation fails
requirements.why_checkable: Malformed trailing data can be injected and the decode_error termination observed.

requirements.quote:
After sending the ClientHello message, the client waits for a
      ServerHello or HelloRetryRequest message.
requirements.required_behavior: enter a state expecting ServerHello or HelloRetryRequest as the next handshake response
requirements.forbidden_behavior: treat another handshake message as the expected response
requirements.why_checkable: The client's next-message acceptance set can be checked in the post-ClientHello state.

requirements.quote:
If early data is in use,
      the client may transmit early Application Data (Section 2.3) while
      waiting for the next handshake message.
requirements.condition: early data is in use and the client is waiting after ClientHello
requirements.required_behavior: permit early Application Data transmission before the next handshake message arrives
requirements.forbidden_behavior: require the next handshake response to arrive before any allowed early Application Data is sent
requirements.why_checkable: The client state machine can be tested for an enabled early-data send transition while awaiting the server response.
